Separating dodge from the action distribution intentionally changes swordsman/sky-mage from a 6000-step draw to a right-side win at 434 steps, and seer/ember from a 250-step draw to a right-side win at 138 steps. The former has no paired cast (cast/movement compatibility still applies); the latter executes one paired shot/dodge. Neither has a pair-admission fizzle. Swordsman/sky-mage path nodes rise from 515 to 545, within 700. Fire/healer retains its outcome and 747 steps with casts +9, log bytes +8311 and trajectory bytes +182. Archer/guardian retains outcome and operation counts, with log bytes +17122 and trajectory bytes +61. The other three vectors are unchanged. Clean-source verification passes 632 tests and 112 mapped regressions, including joint costs, independent random purposes, actual movement and Worker/SQLite/replay. All seven recipes/seeds/characters and published definition hashes are preserved; only current engine/rules identities change. Golden expectations and profile/runtime limits are unchanged. Different input identities require independent transition review: these measurements do not establish same-input timing or RSS improvement, and no failed baseline is waived.

These are regression ceilings, not product capacity or wall-time/RSS guarantees. Failed/missing baseline observations cannot be waived.
